faq.q: What time do NYE charters start and end in Marbella?
faq.a: Most NYE charters depart around 21:30–22:00 to allow time to cruise to a prime fireworks viewing spot and return after midnight. Typical duration is 3–4 hours, but we can customise start times. Contact us via WhatsApp to confirm your preferred slot.

faq.q: Which boat is best for a small group on NYE?
faq.a: For up to 9 guests, the Astondoa 40 (€749/2h) is a great choice. For up to 11 guests, the Azimut 39 (same price) offers a bit more space. Both depart from Puerto Banús and come with a skipper, drinks, and snacks. Book early – these sell out fastest.

faq.q: Can we see the Marbella fireworks from the boat?
faq.a: Yes. The main fireworks display launches from Puerto Banús at midnight. Our boats anchor in the bay just outside the harbour, giving you an unobstructed, front-row view without the crowds. You’ll see the full show reflected on the water.

faq.q: Is the jet ski included with the Mangusta 80 for NYE?
faq.a: Yes, the Mangusta 80 (white or grey) includes a jet ski free of charge on all charters, including NYE. Minimum booking is 4 hours at €4,719. The jet ski is a fun addition for daytime use, but note that night riding is restricted for safety.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad on NYE?
faq.a: We monitor forecasts closely. If conditions are unsafe (strong winds, rough seas), we’ll offer you a full refund or reschedule to another date. December in Marbella is generally mild, but we prioritise safety. You’ll be informed by 12:00 on the day.

faq.q: Are children allowed on NYE boat rentals?
faq.a: Yes, children are welcome on all our boats. Life jackets are provided in all sizes. Note that the maximum passenger count includes everyone on board. For example, the Astondoa 40 holds 9 people total, children included. Check the boat capacity when booking.

faq.q: Can we bring our own food or decorations for NYE?
faq.a: Absolutely. You’re welcome to bring your own food, party decorations, or a cake. We provide a cooler with ice, plus complimentary drinks and snacks. Just avoid glass bottles for safety. Many guests bring balloons and banners to personalise their boat.

faq.q: How do I book a NYE 2044 boat rental in Marbella?
faq.a: Contact us directly via WhatsApp. Provide your preferred date, group size, and duration. We’ll confirm availability and send a booking link. A 50% deposit secures your slot; the balance is due 7 days before departure. Last-minute bookings may be possible but are not guaranteed.

data.body_html:
New Year's Eve 2044 in Marbella is set to be spectacular – and there's no better seat for the midnight fireworks than on the water. With our boat rental Marbella fleet, you'll watch the sky explode over Puerto Banús from a private yacht, with drinks in hand and the Mediterranean lapping beneath you. Prices start at €749 for a two-hour charter on the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, including a licensed skipper, fuel, soft drinks, beer, wine, cava, snacks, insurance, and Spanish VAT. No hidden extras, no crowded promenades – just you, your guests, and the show.

Why Celebrate NYE 2044 on a Boat in Marbella?

Marbella's Puerto Banús fireworks are a highlight of the Costa del Sol calendar. From land, you'll jostle for space along the Golden Mile or the harbour edge. From a boat, you anchor 50 metres offshore with a full, unobstructed view of the display reflected on the water. The December air is crisp (average 16°C), so bring a jacket – but the cava and warm snacks keep the chill at bay. Plus, you avoid the post-fireworks traffic chaos. Your skipper returns you to the marina at your leisure.

Our NYE 2044 Fleet: Which Boat Is Right for You?

We offer a range of vessels departing from Puerto Banús. For small groups of up to 9 guests, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m) or Azimut 39 (12.5m) are the most affordable options at €749 for two hours, or €2,299 for a full eight-hour charter. Both are comfortable, well-equipped, and perfect for an intimate celebration.

For larger parties of up to 12 guests, consider the Mangusta 80 (24m) – available in white or grey – at €4,719 for a minimum of four hours. This charter includes a free jet ski, adding daytime fun if you book a longer slot. Other yachts like the Azimut 58 Flybridge, Canados 86, or Ferretti 94 are available on request via WhatsApp; pricing is customised for your group.

What’s Included in Every NYE Charter?

Every boat rental includes a professional skipper who knows the best anchorage points for the fireworks. Fuel is covered. Onboard, you'll find a cooler with bottled water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava, plus light snacks. Insurance and Spanish IVA (21%) are included – the price you see is the price you pay. There are no surprise charges.

Sample NYE 2044 Itinerary

  • 21:30 – Board your yacht at Puerto Banús. Meet your skipper, stow your decorations, and enjoy a welcome glass of cava.
  • 22:00 – Depart the marina and cruise along the Marbella coastline. Pass the Golden Mile, Río Verde, and Cala del Faro.
  • 23:30 – Anchor in the bay off Puerto Banús. The fireworks launch point is clearly visible. Raise a toast to 2044.
  • 00:00 – Fireworks display. Watch from your flybridge or foredeck. Music optional.
  • 00:30–01:00 – Return to Puerto Banús. Disembark at your leisure.

Tips for an Unforgettable NYE on the Water

Book early – NYE 2044 slots are limited and typically sell out by mid-December. Bring warm layers: even in Marbella, December evenings can be cool on the water. You're welcome to bring your own food and decorations; we provide coolers with ice. Avoid glass bottles for safety. If you want to extend the celebration, consider a daytime charter on 31 December or 1 January to explore Cabopino, Estepona, or Sotogrande.

How to Book Your NYE 2044 Boat Rental

Contact us directly via WhatsApp with your preferred boat, group size, and duration. We'll confirm availability and send a booking link. A 50% deposit secures your slot; the balance is due seven days before departure. For last-minute enquiries, we'll do our best to accommodate you.
